pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with sharp edge gradients along the dorsal and cervical areas. Patch spatial area is smaller on the neck and increases in size toward the mid-flank, where edges appear slightly more diffuse.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous negative-space graph of light-toned pelage. Junction nodes typically connect three to four pathways. Pixel thickness is non-uniform, with noticeably wider pathways at the intersection nodes on the lateral torso compared to the neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth silhouette visible along the superior boundary of the neck, consisting of short, vertical fiber clusters.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian organism (oxpecker) on the lower ventral-lateral region of the neck.
